value: GNUstep Make reserves several top-level phony targets using double-colon rules (e.g. check::, install::, clean::) defined in $(GNUSTEP_MAKEFILES)/Master/rules.make. Custom GNUmakefiles must NOT redefine these with single-colon rules (causes 'has both : and :: entries' error). Instead, hook into the corresponding double-colon extension points: before-<target>::, internal-<target>::, or after-<target>::. Example: to add custom logic to 'make check', define 'internal-check::' rather than 'check:'. Discovered while implementing appscript-z0t. Worth writing up as generic GNUstep Make documentation for reuse across projects and by other agents.
